title: Grimgar of Fantasy and Ash — Meaning, Genes, And Nothing Else #Shorts
description:
The bleak reading of Grimgar of Fantasy and Ash is also the most testable one. Grimgar of Fantasy and Ash (灰と幻想のグリムガル, Hai to Gensō no Gurimugaru) is a Japanese light novel series written by Ao Jūmonji and illustrated by Eiri Shirai. The story follows a group of people who suddenly find themselves in a fantasy world with no memories from before their arrival, and chronicles their struggles to survive and make a life for themselves as volunteer soldiers.

Modern psychology keeps rediscovering what the pessimists said first about Grimgar of Fantasy and Ash. A 10-minute original video animation numbered "episode 2.5" was bundled with the first Blu-ray and DVD volume of the anime, which was released on 16 March 2016. Toho streamed a promotional video for the OVA on 5 February 2016.
